messages:
violet: Tiny WFH saga: woke up to my router chewed by a raccoon (not my finest morning). scrambled to get back online for the 9am demo.

kai: oh no. raccoon router. how did you recover?

violet: unplugged, moved router to a shelf, tethered my phone, then ran a short ethernet under the couch with gaffer tape. demo survived. :sweat_smile:

maggie: bless the gaffer tape. post-raccoon checklist? :memo:

violet: 1) check hardware for bite marks 2) document serial for warranty 3) keep backup dongle 4) sell raccoon story as a webinar title later.

ops-bot: ops-bot: No ISP outage detected for residential cluster at 2027-07-22T08:00:00Z. Localized hardware failures reported are user-level.

sam: vote: webinar title ideas: "Taming the Wild Router" or "Raccoon vs Router: A Zoom Survival Guide" react :tada: or :joy:

kai: also quick tip: if ethernet looks frayed, swap it; cross-sectioned cables give intermittent faults that are pain to debug mid-call.

violet: thanks all — ordering a small weatherproof box for the router and a spare USB-C dongle to keep in my desk. will add the incident to #devex WFH hacks with a warning: raccoons are not tech support. :raccoon:
